title: Finance Sector Code of Corporate Governance (as amended 10 June 2021: principle 5.2.1 Climate change and Appendix 3 principle A:18)
citation: Guernsey Financial Services Commission, Finance Sector Code of Corporate Governance, issued 30 September 2011, amended 18 February 2016 and 10 June 2021
evidence: Code, "When did the Code become effective?": "The Code came into effect on 1 January 2012. Principle 5.2.1 and Principle A:18 of Appendix 3 will come into effect for financial years starting from 1 st October 2021." Opened https://www.gfsc.gg/sites/default/files/inline-files/Finance%20Sector%20Code%20of%20Corporate%20Governance%202021.pdf on 2026-11-10 (HTTP 200, 345278 bytes, application/pdf, sha256 2a99e0cd2a8527f8105212df679d77ef08765fa2b5e53ac6bcf79231d5daa57f). Found through https://www.gfsc.gg/news/considering-climate-change-commission-publishes-updated-finance-sector-code-corporate (10 June 2021).
notes: Link only: row GG-GFSC-CONSOLIDATED fails. The date is the Code's first effect; the climate provision (principle 5.2.1: "The Board should consider the impact of climate change on the firm's business strategy and risk profile and, where appropriate in the judgement of the board, make timely climate change related disclosures.") applies from financial years starting 2021-10-01. Whether the Code binds a licensee by itself or through licensing rules was not checked. Not in the brief; added because it is the GFSC's only climate disclosure provision found. English only.
status_note: Row GG-GFSC-CONSOLIDATED is fail; nothing stored.

title: The Trading Standards (Fair Trading) (Guernsey) Ordinance, 2023 (P.2023/9)
citation: Trading Standards (Fair Trading) (Guernsey) Ordinance, 2023, approved by the States of Deliberation on 31 March 2023 on proposition P.2023/9
evidence: Draft s.206(1): "This Ordinance shall come into force on the date appointed by regulations of the Committee; and different dates may be appointed for different purposes." (https://www.gov.gg/CHttpHandler.ashx?id=164587&p=0, HTTP 200, 2104155 bytes, application/pdf, sha256 bdf223f6cd249b6b01e18f2de4fc38a9b069ad2eb3f88af54ced7b4450482ab1, opened 2026-11-10). gov.gg news item of Tuesday 3 October 2023, https://gov.gg/article/198052/: "The new Trading Standards legislation has come into force". No official page read states the date.
notes: Link only: row GG-GOV-ADOPTED fails (reproduction for research, private study and internal circulation only) and the enacted consolidated text sits on the Guernsey Legal Resources portal, which answers HTTP 403. Umbrella consumer law, not an environmental-claims law: Part IV (s.102 and s.104 misleading actions) covers false or deceiving commercial practices about "the main characteristics of the product"; the draft contains no word "environmental" or "green". Guernsey only. Ogier and other law-firm notes give 2 October 2023 as the start; no commencement regulations were found on an official page, so in_force stays empty.
status_note: The commencement regulations under s.206 were not found; the date is not stated on any official page opened.
